SELECT DISTINCT ti.* FROM t_indicator ti JOIN t_indicator_dept_scope tids ON ti.metric_code = tids.metric_code WHERE ti.status = 1
AND ti.metric_pool = #{pool}
-- 科室范围：当前科室本身，如果当前科室是业务单元（dept_level > 1），则允许继承其直属父科室（主科室）的指标 AND tids.root_dept_id IN ( SELECT #{deptId} UNION SELECT parent_id FROM sys_dept WHERE dept_id = #{deptId} AND parent_id > 0 AND dept_level > 1 ) -- 业务方向过滤：指标的方向包含在用户的方向列表中
AND (
ti.business_direction LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dir}, '%')
)
ORDER BY ti.sort_order

SELECT DISTINCT tids.metric_code FROM t_indicator_dept_scope tids WHERE tids.root_dept_id IN ( -- 当前科室本身 SELECT #{deptId} UNION -- 如果当前科室是业务单元（dept_level > 1），则允许继承其直属父科室的指标 SELECT parent_id FROM sys_dept WHERE dept_id = #{deptId} AND parent_id > 0 AND dept_level > 1 )
